question: List the members of a network of noncoding regulatory RNAs that play a role in the mammalian brain

supports.quote: The long ncRNA Cyrano uses an extensively paired site to miR-7 to trigger destruction of this microRNA.
The long ncRNA Cyrano uses an extensively paired site to miR-7 to trigger destruction of this microRNA.
By reducing miR-7 levels, Cyrano prevents repression of miR-7-targeted mRNAs and enables accumulation of Cdr1as, a circular RNA known to regulate neuronal activity.
Without Cyrano, excess miR-7 causes cytoplasmic destruction of Cdr1as in neurons, in part through enhanced slicing of Cdr1as by a second miRNA, miR-671.

initial_executor.limitations: Evidence is derived from a study using gene editing in mice; the network is described as centered on these four ncRNAs, but other members may exist outside this specific network description.
